description: A build without app.quit: nothing is sent; the user closes the window after the project is saved.

error.detail: this OpenTune build does not report the capability app.quit

nextStep.message: This OpenTune build cannot be closed by request. If the project has a file, write a copy first with opentune_save_project (mode autosave) and ask the user whether to save the project file before they close the OpenTune window themselves. Older OpenTune builds close the window without asking about unsaved changes, so do not rely on the window to ask.
